name: llm-wiki-fortissimo
description: HORDE fork of nvk/llm-wiki — LLM-compiled knowledge base customized for the Fortissimo AI OS Reference Corpus pillar. Adds workspace sentinel resolution (.fortissimo-vault.json), wikis.json isolation flags (commons/client/personal), and Fortissimo frontmatter fields (pillar/source_provenance/em_refs/supersedes) on top of nvk's algorithms and topology.

plugins.name: wiki
plugins.description: HORDE fork of nvk/llm-wiki. LLM-compiled knowledge base. Commands: /wiki:init (workspace bootstrap), /wiki:topic (topic creation with isolation flag), /wiki:wiki (natural-language router + status/config), /wiki:ingest, /wiki:compile, /wiki:query (quick/standard/deep/--resume), /wiki:ll (lessons learned), /wiki:research (5-10 parallel agents, --new-topic, --min-time, --mode thesis), /wiki:audit, /wiki:librarian, /wiki:assess, /wiki:plan, /wiki:lint, /wiki:refresh, /wiki:output, /wiki:retract, /wiki:project. HORDE additions: workspace sentinel, isolation flags, Fortissimo frontmatter.
